images.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one beautifully art-directed collection of EIGHT CAT AVATARS for an elegant chat application. Create ONE landscape image aspect ratio exactly 2:1, 2048x1024, with precisely four columns and two rows of equal invisible square cells. No labels, no text, no gridlines or boxes, no logo. Pure warm-white paper backdrop across the entire sheet. Each cat portrait centered in its own square at x=12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5% and y=25%,75%; keep the entire head, all ears and very short chest inside the central 72% of its cell with generous safe padding. This is sophisticated modern newspaper editorial illustration meeting a gentle European picture book: lively flowing BLACK INK lines with beautiful varied line weight, human hand-drawn irregularity, witty subtle personalities, masterful negative space. Strict BLACK and WHITE only, bold solid black ink patches and beautifully economical contour strokes. NO gray washes, NO hatching shadows, NO textures, NO shading, NO gradients. NOT generic vector clip-art, NOT cute emoji, NOT symmetrical logo outlines, NOT anime. Draw expressive individual faces with very simple eyes and small noses, short whiskers only when useful, a few portraits slightly turned or tilted. Simplify fur to just a handful of confident tapered strokes. A harmonious cohesive collection with a different head shape for each breed. Exact reading order: TOP LEFT a gentle fluffy Ragdoll, white face with dark ears and delicately defined cheeks, thoughtful wide-set eyes; TOP SECOND a wise stern Maine Coon, longer angular face, obvious pointed ear tufts and long chin silhouette, one amused raised brow; TOP THIRD a mischievous Siamese, slender head with LARGE ears and an elegant solid black face mask with white eye cutouts, slight curious tilt; TOP RIGHT a peaceful Turkish Van, roundish white head and asymmetrical solid black patches on crown and one ear, relaxed half-closed eyes. BOTTOM LEFT a round British/domestic shorthair CAT, smooth near-circle face, dark solid head with white muzzle, compact tiny ears, mildly skeptical expression; BOTTOM SECOND an alert Chinese tabby, two broad black forehead stripes and sharper cheeks, gaze slightly to one side; BOTTOM THIRD a curious Bengal, lean head, several large and spare ink spots, impish little expression; BOTTOM RIGHT a dignified golden chinchilla translated into black-and-white, fluffy round head, creamy white muzzle and bib, soft eyes. Refined graceful charming cats, genuinely strong original editorial illustration, complete isolated busts, no props or extra objects. High readability at 48px. Ensure 8 separate cats in a strict 4x2 grid.
images.notes: Black-and-white editorial ink portrait direction. Generation retained more fine fur strokes than the minimal brief.

images.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Draw an ULTRA MINIMAL FLAT 2D avatar sprite sheet for a modern conversational AI app. Exactly eight abstract CAT HEADS in a strict four-column two-row grid on a perfectly uniform solid medium gray #92918e background. Canvas 2048x1024, exact landscape 2:1. Every icon centered in an identical invisible square cell, x=12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5%, y=25%,75%. Each entire silhouette fits inside central 70% of its square; all ears completely visible and safe for circular avatar cropping. Design language inspired by remarkably reductive bot avatars: friendly chunky rounded organic head silhouette, two triangle/rounded-triangle ears integrated into silhouette, EXACTLY TWO SOLID DARK VERTICAL CAPSULE EYES. All eight have the same simple vertical capsule-eye system: two black rounded vertical bars about 1:2.4 width-to-height ratio, evenly spaced. ABSOLUTELY NO nose. ABSOLUTELY NO mouth. NO whiskers. NO eye pupils. NO iris. NO highlights. NO eye outlines. NO realistic cat facial detail. NO body, no legs, no props. Cat-like abstract bot faces made from only TWO OR THREE large solid color shapes plus the two eyes. ZERO outlines or strokes, ZERO gradients, ZERO shading, ZERO texture, ZERO shadows. High-end restrained precise design, 2D paper cutout simplicity. Muted palette of warm cream, clay terracotta, dusty blue, cool pale gray and muted golden ochre. Make individual breeds recognizable only through head silhouette, ear shape and large simplified fur patches, not anatomy or details. Exact icon order: TOP LEFT Ragdoll: soft wide cream head, two small brown ear caps and connected brown upper face patch, black capsule eyes clear against cream eye area; TOP SECOND Maine Coon: elongated broad muted gray-brown head, two pointed ears with extremely simple tiny tufts, cream lower face; TOP THIRD Siamese: cream head with extra-large dark clay-brown ears and a broad flat brown mask, use dark-charcoal capsule eyes visible on light enough brown mask; TOP RIGHT Turkish Van: round white-cream head with a single asymmetric terracotta upper-left crown and ear patch. BOTTOM LEFT blue-gray shorthair: very round dusty blue face and short integrated ears, no markings; BOTTOM SECOND Chinese tabby: muted warm taupe head with ONLY TWO chunky darker forehead bars, no other stripes; BOTTOM THIRD Bengal: muted golden-clay head with only THREE big dark spots at upper outer head, no other detail; BOTTOM RIGHT golden chinchilla: warm pale golden rounded head, one large offwhite lower-face semicircle, absolutely NO mouth or nose in this cream shape. Do not add readable text, titles, numbers, grids, frames, separators, circles behind heads or brand logos. The impression must be minimalist bot characters with ONLY capsule eyes, never animal cartoons with complete faces.
images.refinementPrompt: Precise style correction to this existing eight-cat avatar sheet. Preserve the exact eight characters, silhouettes, colors, capsule eyes, positions, sizes, grid, canvas aspect ratio, and the absence of noses and mouths. CHANGE ONLY RENDERING: eliminate ALL gradients, lighting, texture, photographic effects, paper grain, highlights, noise and shadows anywhere in the entire image. Every bounded shape must be one PERFECTLY UNIFORM SOLID RGB COLOR with mathematically clean edges, like an SVG exported from a vector editor. Whole background must be one identical solid medium gray #92918e from edge to edge. The cream shapes are solid #f4ecda, gray-brown #87796d, brown #805e49, terracotta #bc784f, dusty blue #8190a1, golden #cba167, dark eyes #1b1b1b. Each cat only 2-3 opaque flat color regions; remove the extra light triangular patchwork on the golden cat so it has only solid golden head and solid cream lower-face semicircle. NO TEXT. NO other changes. This is strictly flat digital VECTOR-style art, not painted paper or physical material. No new details.
images.notes: Capsule-eye-only minimalist heads. Minor tonal variation from native generation may remain; use SVG for strict solid-color production.
